figure_caption: Setting and compared constructions. With labels, unlabeled records and the predictor fixed, three intervals are built from the same data: the labeled-only interval, PPI++ (scalar weight on $\hat Y$), and recalibrated PPI (cross-fitted $g(\hat Y)$ as an additional control variate, with a fallback to PPI++). Each is scored by empirical coverage and by the width ratio to PPI++; the achievable narrowing is bounded by the drop from $\mathrm{Var}(Y-\lambda\hat Y)$ to the residual variance of the best $g$.

panels.title: Setting, nested constructions and evaluation
panels.short_caption: Fixed inputs feed three nested intervals, each scored by coverage and width ratio to PPI++.
panels.drawio_prompt:
SINGLE IDEA: with labels, unlabeled records and the predictor all fixed, three nested intervals are built from the same data and each is scored against PPI++; the figure shows what is being shortened and relative to what. One connected left-to-right diagram in three zones (Inputs, Constructions, Evaluation), wide 21:9 canvas.

ZONE A (left, 'Fixed inputs'), enclosed by a group frame labeled 'Held fixed':
- L1: sharp data box 'Labeled pairs $$(Y_i,\hat Y_i)$$' with a small tag '$$n$$'.
- U1: sharp data box 'Unlabeled $$\hat Y_j$$' with tag '$$N$$'.
- P1: rounded box (frozen, padlock/frozen marker) 'Predictor (frozen)'.
- X1: small struck-through/off-limits note box 'No new labels, data, retraining' (not a flow node; attached under the frame).
Edges (solid, forward flow): P1 → L1 and P1 → U1 (label 'predicts $$\hat Y$$'); L1 → ZONE B and U1 → ZONE B (joined by a single bus arrow into the constructions column, no label).

ZONE B (center, 'Same data, three intervals'), three horizontal interval rows stacked top-to-bottom, drawn as nested intervals: each row is a number-line segment with a centered point estimate tick and end caps, all rows centered on the same vertical axis, with widths strictly decreasing downward so each narrower interval visibly sits inside the one above (nesting). A thin vertical dashed guide marks the shared center.
- C1 (top, widest interval): row label 'Labeled-only' with a small tag 'no control variate'.
- C2 (middle): row label 'PPI++' with tag 'scalar weight on $$\hat Y$$, clipped'. Marked as the reference interval (importance: reference).
- C3 (bottom, narrowest, most important): row label 'Recalibrated PPI' with tag 'adds cross-fitted $$g(\hat Y)$$'. Beside it a small rounded box K1 'Cross-fit recalibrator (isotonic / binned)' feeding C3 via a solid edge labeled '$$g(\hat Y)$$'.
- Edge F1 (dashed, curved, C3 → C2) labeled 'Fallback to PPI++'.
- Edges C1 → C2 and C2 → C3 are small solid down-arrows between rows labeled '+ control variate $$\hat Y$$' and '+ control variate $$g(\hat Y)$$' respectively (shorter than the row labels; text budget below).
- HEADROOM H1: a bracket spanning the width difference between C2 and C3 (the gap between their right ends), labeled 'Headroom'. Under the bracket, the ONE equation of the figure, as a compact annotation: '$$\mathrm{Var}(Y-\lambda\hat Y)\;\to\;\text{residual var of best } g$$'. This is the single raw formula allowed; everything else is named.

ZONE C (right, 'Evaluation protocol'):
- E1: rounded process box 'Sealed draws' with small tag '100 draws per family' and a tiny glyph row of five family chips: 'Census ×3', 'Plankton', 'Synthetic'.
- E2: rounded process box 'Empirical coverage' (scoring output 1), with a small gauge/target glyph and tag 'nominal 0.95'.
- E3: rounded process box 'Width ratio to PPI++' (scoring output 2), with tag 'positive = narrower'.
- E4: small sharp box 'Validity gate' (binomial coverage tests, controls pass) sitting after E2.
Edges: C1, C2, C3 each → E1 via three thin solid arrows merging into one bus (no labels); E1 → E2 (solid); E1 → E3 (solid); E2 → E4 (solid). A dashed reference edge from C2 (PPI++) → E3 labeled 'reference' shows that width is measured relative to PPI++.

SPATIAL LAYOUT: Zone A occupies roughly the left 22% of width, vertically centered; Zone B the middle ~48%, three rows evenly stacked and centered on a common axis; Zone C the right ~30%, E1 on the left of the zone and E2/E3 stacked on its right with E4 beneath E2. Zone frames are light group rectangles with zone titles at the top ('Inputs', 'Constructions', 'Evaluation'). Keep C2 vertically aligned with E3 so the reference edge runs horizontal.

IMPORTANCE RANKING: (1) C3 recalibrated interval and the Headroom bracket H1; (2) C2 PPI++ reference and E3 width ratio; (3) C1; (4) inputs and E1/E2/E4. The Style phase decides emphasis visually.
